policy.primaryRule: Prefer official sources and RSS feeds. Use media reports for context. Treat community posts as trend signals until confirmed by official sources or reliable reporting.
policy.language: Summaries for the site should be written in Chinese, with source links preserved.
policy.claimSafety: Do not present rumors, leaks, or community speculation as facts. Label them as unconfirmed signals when included.

trustLevels.official: Official company, lab, platform, or research organization source.
trustLevels.reliable_media: Established media or industry publication. Useful for context and market movement.
trustLevels.research: Academic or research-focused source. Useful for papers, benchmarks, and technical direction.
trustLevels.community_signal: Community or trend source. Useful for discovery, not final confirmation.

sources.name: OpenAI News
sources.notes: Use for OpenAI product releases, model updates, safety notes, research, and global affairs.

sources.name: OpenAI Developers RSS
sources.notes: Use for API, developer tooling, and platform updates.

sources.name: Anthropic Newsroom
sources.notes: Use for Claude releases, Anthropic policy posts, company announcements, and safety updates.

sources.name: Google DeepMind Blog
sources.notes: Use for Gemini, DeepMind research, AI science, and responsibility updates.

sources.name: Mistral AI News
sources.notes: Use for Mistral model releases, platform updates, and open model strategy.

sources.name: Hugging Face Blog
sources.notes: Use for open-source model, dataset, tooling, and community engineering updates.

sources.name: NVIDIA AI Blog
sources.notes: Use for AI infrastructure, GPU ecosystem, enterprise AI, and model acceleration updates.

sources.name: Meta AI Blog
sources.notes: Use for Llama, Meta AI research, open models, and product integration updates.

sources.name: Microsoft AI Blog
sources.notes: Use for Copilot, Azure AI, enterprise deployment, and Microsoft AI strategy.

sources.name: arXiv cs.AI
sources.notes: Use for artificial intelligence preprints. Summaries should avoid overstating unreviewed claims.

sources.name: arXiv cs.CL
sources.notes: Use for NLP and language model research preprints.

sources.name: arXiv cs.CV
sources.notes: Use for computer vision, image generation, and multimodal research preprints.

sources.name: TechCrunch AI
sources.notes: Use for startup, funding, and product market coverage.

sources.name: VentureBeat AI
sources.notes: Use for enterprise AI adoption, business strategy, and market context.

sources.name: MIT Technology Review AI
sources.notes: Use for deeper analysis of AI research, society, and policy impact.

sources.name: Hacker News AI Search
sources.notes: Use only as a discovery signal. Confirm important items elsewhere before publishing as facts.

sources.name: GitHub Trending AI Topics
sources.notes: Use to discover fast-moving open-source tools. Verify project quality before featuring.

sources.name: Product Hunt AI
sources.notes: Use for early product discovery. Treat popularity as a signal, not proof of quality.

sources.name: Reuters Technology
sources.notes: Use for reliable reporting on AI company strategy, capital markets, regulation, acquisitions, and infrastructure moves.

sources.name: Bloomberg Technology
sources.notes: Use for AI capital spending, IPO/listing context, hyperscaler strategy, chips, and market-moving company coverage.

sources.name: CNBC Technology
sources.notes: Use for public-company AI spending, executive statements, chip demand, and acquisition or market context.

sources.name: The Information AI
sources.notes: Use for AI company strategy, fundraising, leadership, and competitive dynamics; verify paywalled claims carefully before publishing.

sources.name: Axios AI / Technology
sources.notes: Use for AI policy, market structure, leadership, and geopolitical context when official confirmation is unavailable or incomplete.

sources.name: Financial Times Technology
sources.notes: Use for AI company strategy, regulation, capital markets, and geopolitical technology coverage. Treat paywalled pages as must-read references and avoid reconstructing full articles.

sources.name: The Guardian Technology
sources.notes: Use for AI policy, society, labor, infrastructure, and public-interest analysis. Keep opinion or scenario coverage clearly labeled as analysis rather than confirmed fact.

sources.name: MarketWatch Technology
sources.notes: Use for market-facing AI company, talent, capital, and public-equity context. Verify company actions against official statements when available.

sources.name: Wall Street Journal AI & Technology
sources.notes: Use for AI business strategy, capital spending, power constraints, chips, and company competition. Keep paywalled/newsletter coverage as media background and avoid reconstructing full articles.

sources.name: Business Insider AI / Tech
sources.notes: Use for AI company, government adoption, workforce, and market context. Keep media facts minimal and verify official actions when available.

sources.name: The Verge AI
sources.notes: Use for AI product, platform, developer-tool, and policy coverage. Treat previews and teasers as media background until official launch details are available.
